item.title: Early Alert: Esophageal pH Monitoring Capsule Delivery Device Issue from Medtronic and Given Imaging
item.description: The Medtronic and Given Imaging Bravo CF esophageal pH monitoring capsule can fail to attach to the esophagus or detach from its delivery device.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Convenience Kit Correction: AVID Medical Issues Correction for Kits Containing Medline Namic Star Off Handle Manifolds
item.description: AVID Medical is correcting convenience kits containing Manifolds affected by the Medline Namic Angiographic Star Off Handle Manifold Recall.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Baxter Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall for Two Lots of 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection Due to Potential Presence of Particulate Matter
item.description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE – AUG. 25, 2026 – DEERFIELD, Ill., Baxter International Inc. (NYSE:BAX) is voluntarily recalling two lots of 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection due to the potential presence of particulate matter identified as fiberglass in the solution.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Percutaneous Catheter Recall: Boston Scientific Removes ENROUTE Transcarotid Neuroprotection System
item.description: ENROUTE Transcarotid Neuroprotection Systems may have arterial sheath tip separation or partial tip separation during use.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Early Alert: Heart Pump Controller Purge Cassette Issue from Abiomed
item.description: Abiomed is removing Automated Impella Controllers due to purge cassette recognition failures that may lead to prolonged delayed in mechanical circulatory support.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Baxter Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall for One Lot of Anticoagulant Sodium Citrate Solution Due to Potential Presence of Particulate Matter
item.description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE – AUG. 25, 2026 – DEERFIELD, Ill., Baxter International Inc. (NYSE:BAX) is voluntarily recalling one lot of Anticoagulant Sodium Citrate Solution due to the potential presence of particulate matter identified as fiberglass in the solution.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Baxter Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall for One Lot of 70% Dextrose Injection Due to Potential Presence of Particulate Matter
item.description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE – AUG. 25, 2026 – DEERFIELD, Ill., Baxter International Inc. (NYSE:BAX) is voluntarily recalling one lot of 70% Dextrose Injection due to the potential presence of particulate matter identified as stainless steel particles in the solution.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Early Alert: Convenience Kit Issue from AVID Medical
item.description: Certain AVID Medical convenience kits containing recalled BD ChloraPrep applicators should be removed from use due to potential fungal contamination
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Early Alert: Ventilator Issue from CooperSurgical
item.description: The cannula sets may exhibit a loose connection between the flexible tubing and the nasal cannula resulting in reduced effectiveness and decreased oxygenation.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Early Alert: Nitric Oxide Delivery System Issue from NOxBOX
item.description: The NOxBOX NOxBOXi System may leak oxygen during inhaled nitric oxide therapy
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Early Alert: Convenience Kit Issue from Medline
item.description: Certain Medline convenience kits containing recalled BD ChloraPrep applicators should be removed from use due to potential fungal contamination
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Vitruvias Therapeutics, Inc Issues Nationwide Recall of One Lot of Thyroid Tablets, USP 30 mg Due to Potential Super Potency
item.description: AUBURN, Ala. (August 21, 2026) – Vitruvias Therapeutics, Inc. is voluntarily recalling one lot (Lot. No. 504950) of Thyroid Tablets, USP 30 mg to the consumer level. The product is being recalled because testing confirmed the potential for the product to be superpotent.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Early Alert: Epidural Kit Issue from Medical Action Industries
item.description: Medical Action Industries is correcting epidural kits containing recalled Huons Co. sodium chloride ampules.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Early Alert: Breathing Circuit Issue from Medline
item.description: Medline is recalling certain neonatal and infant heated wire breathing circuits due to failures involving the electrical connector.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Early Alert: Portrait Core Services Software Issue from GE HealthCare
item.description: Patients monitored on Portrait Mobile devices can be discharged (removed) from the Portrait monitoring system during an update to the Portrait Core Services software.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Convenience Kit Recall: Medline Issues Correction for Convenience Kits Containing B. Braun Bupivacaine Hydrochloride Components
item.description: Medline is correcting affected convenience kits by removing included B. Braun components containing Huons Bupivacaine Hydrochloride in Dextrose Injection, USP.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Optimal Balance Pharmacy Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall of Certain Lots of Compounded Glutathione 200 mg/mL Multi-Dose Vials Due to Elevated Endotoxin Levels
item.description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE – August 19, 2026 – Houston, Texas, Optimal Balance Pharmacy is voluntarily recalling one lot of Compounded Glutathione 200 MG/ML 30 ML Multi-Dose Vials to the patient level. The product is being recalled because pharmacy testing identified elevated bacterial endotoxin levels.
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Early Alert: Convenience Kit Issue from Becton Dickinson
item.description: BD is correcting convenience kits and procedural trays containing recalled Huons Co. sodium chloride ampules
item.dc:creator: FDA

item.title: Intraosseous Needle Set Recall: Becton Dickinson Removes Certain Intraosseous Vascular Access System Needle Sets
item.description: BD is recalling certain BD Intraosseous Vascular Access System Needle Sets due to difficulty removing the obturator (stylet) following placement.
